entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one clean high-resolution 16:9 environment reference image for the NIHON QUEST V00 cinematic, NOT a storyboard montage. Transform the supplied apple-farm environment reference into a new nearby modest village market street using its timber, gray tile, natural fabric, foliage and daylight material language. This is a new candidate setting, not an exact historical reconstruction. Subject: a quiet northern Japanese-inspired everyday village before knowledge disappears. An apple vendor's open wooden stall and an OPEN small woodworking shop directly beside it, both clearly visible along one walkable gently curving street, so a continuous lateral camera move can link the stall, sign and workshop. The vendor stall has a simple muted terracotta cloth awning, red apples, low slatted wooden produce trays, two small shallow round wicker baskets. A large blank pale wooden sign mounted low enough for a child to point to. At the adjacent open-front workshop, a low sturdy workbench visible with a hand plane and half-worked wooden board. Large simple shapes, softened bevels, matte hand-painted miniature 3D game environment. Charming grounded rural world; restrained material detail matching simple 3-head-tall toy-like characters, not photorealistic, no painterly outlines, no pixel art. Soft morning sunlight from upper left, warm pale timber, gray roofs, moss greens, cream plaster; easy-to-read foreground staging space and continuous geography. Eye-level wide 35mm equivalent, moderate depth of field, stage remains legible. No people or creatures. No castle, pagoda palace, fountain, modern city, electric signs, European medieval details, glitter, glowing runes, sparkle effects or fog. Signs and sheets completely blank, no letters or numerals, no UI, no labels, no watermark. Fill entire frame with the environment, not an isolated diorama on a display pedestal. Keep the shop and workshop adjacent and small.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a compact original supporting-resident cast reference sheet for NIHON QUEST V00. Replace the supplied protagonist character sheet with FIVE DIFFERENT original background residents while preserving ONLY its polished matte 3D figure rendering, sculpted simple hair masses, gentle facial modeling, simple clothes and miniature proportions. Do NOT duplicate the protagonist's identity, teal jacket, cream round collar, gem clasp, upturned forelock, shorts or boots. Not named story heroes. On a plain warm-light-gray studio background, arrange FIVE generously spaced vertical columns. In each column show one full-body neutral three-quarter view above, and two head studies below of THAT SAME resident, calm everyday face then quietly confused/worried face. All 5 full bodies fully in frame, clear hands and feet, no overlapping columns. Left to right: 1 friendly middle-aged apple shopkeeper, stocky woman, dark hair tied low, muted rust shirt, plain cream work apron, brown wide trousers and low clogs; 2 curious 7-year-old child, small round black bob without hero forelock, mustard-yellow simple smock, dark brown knee-length pants and simple flat shoes, no hat or bag; 3 older woodworking artisan man, salt-and-pepper short hair, gently broad eyebrows, plain navy rolled-sleeve work tunic, ochre waist apron, brown trousers, sturdy low shoes; 4 traveler woman, taller lean silhouette, tied-back dark hair, desaturated sage wrap coat, ankle-length skirt, small brown shoulder pouch, flat walking shoes; 5 traveler man, rounder silhouette, short dark hair, muted clay-red short travel jacket, slate trousers, cloth backpack, simple low shoes. Adults approximately 3.2 heads tall, child 2.6 heads, all share toy-like world proportions. Original humble Japanese rural-fantasy clothing, NO ornate pattern, weapons, capes, armor, gold trim, flowers or sparkles. Soft natural feminine vs masculine faces without caricature. Style: premium simplified 3D game NPC lineup, large readable shapes, matte fabric and skin, subtle tactile texture, not realistic humans, not highly detailed anime illustration. Same soft neutral studio lighting throughout. No text, no captions, no numbered labels, no logos or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NIHON QUEST V00 C04 woodworking shop continuity plate. From the supplied village street reference, create a closer camera view INSIDE THE SAME open-front woodworking shop immediately to the right of the terracotta-awning apple stall. Preserve its timber posts, gray roof language, low sturdy workbench, simple shelves, warm matte wood, cream hanging cloth and soft morning daylight. Show the shop from a human waist-high three-quarter camera so an adult 3-head-tall toy-like carpenter can stand behind the bench; reserve clearly visible empty standing room behind it. The foreground workbench has one compact rectangular wooden-bodied hand plane with a visible dark metal cutting blade, a pale half-planed board aligned along the bench and a few large curled shavings. One simple wooden stool, a restrained rack of boards, no clutter of unrelated tools. The workbench's object layout is clear enough to repeat exactly before and after the carpenter forgets how to use the tool. At the far left edge through the open front, a small sliver of the same muted terracotta awning and red apple stall confirms adjacency, do not invent a different shop. Large simple forms, high-quality miniature stylized 3D game environment with matte painted surfaces and subtle texture, no intricate ornament. Keep wood grain restrained, no photorealism. Natural empty everyday setting, not a product diorama. 16:9 landscape, whole-frame environment, no people or creatures, no letters, no labels, no watermarks, no modern machinery, no magic effects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NIHON QUEST V00 C05 town-outskirts fork continuity plate. Re-stage the provided village material and daylight reference as the nearby edge of the SAME humble rural village. 16:9 landscape eye-level 35mm equivalent view of a clearly readable Y-shaped dirt path. One branch curves left toward modest gray-tile timber houses and low stone walls; the other curves right toward beech woodland. One simple wooden signpost at the fork has EXACTLY TWO broad unmarked wooden directional boards, one pointing each way. The sign surfaces are completely blank pale wood, ready for names to be composited later. A distant small house also has one blank pale sign, so information loss can be shown without changing objects. Generous unobstructed foreground space for TWO travelers to stand looking at each other and the sign; pathways and sign must be readable behind them. Same restrained palette of warm timber, muted gray roofing, moss green, terracotta details, and soft morning light from upper left. High-quality simplified matte hand-painted 3D miniature RPG environment; large rounded readable shapes; subtle tactile textures; NOT a realistic photograph, not pixel art. No new spectacle, castles, ornate shrines, giant mountains or dramatic cliffs. No figures, no creatures, no text or numerals, no label boxes, no UI, no watermark. Do not transform the geography or destroy the village to show forgetting; this is the normal intact location.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NIHON QUEST V00 C06 beech woodland guide-path continuity plate. Reference image 1 supplies soft mossy forest material and light, not its battle arena composition; reference image 2 supplies the same world's grounded matte wood/stone miniature rendering and morning warmth. Compose a NEW nearby forest footpath, not a round combat arena. A narrow gently bending earth trail leads from broad visible foreground up through smooth pale-gray beech trunks with subtle patches of pale lichen and large simple green leaf masses. Trail bends behind a mossy boulder at mid-depth, giving a small forest creature a clear direction to point. One shallow creek may be visible off to the left but does not cut the path. Leave an uncluttered staging patch of ground at lower center for a knee-high creature with root feet, and keep its future silhouette readable against the background. Soft dappled MORNING daylight, calm and welcoming before knowledge is lost, no ominous atmosphere baked into the environment. Wide 16:9 eye-level low-medium camera, 35mm equivalent, moderate depth of field, clean large shapes with tactile matte painted 3D forms, restrained rather than hyper-detailed foliage. No humans, no creatures, no wooden creature statues, no spirits or eyes in the trees. No palace, torii, magic runes, glitter, overexposed bloom, fog, titles, labels, logos or watermark. Show a complete real-in-world landscape, not isolated diorama props.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NIHON QUEST existing normal species Bunakko high-resolution candidate character-state reference sheet, NOT a new starter and NOT an evolution chart. The supplied human sheet is ONLY a rendering/material reference; replace the human completely with an original small beech-tree spirit based on these existing game motifs. Design: one short smooth pale gray beech TRUNK as head-and-body, with a friendly little face embedded in the upper trunk, two dark rounded eyes and a small simple mouth; two short twig arms with small leaf tips; two chunky spreading root feet. A single broad round canopy of large simple moss-green leaf clumps sits on top like a mushroom-shaped haircut, with two tiny triangular beechnuts hanging near its sides. Lichen patches are pale cream irregular marks on the gray trunk. Distinctive silhouette is an actual tiny leafy TREE, not an owl, pig, broccoli human, mammal or grass-starter imitation. No clothes, no pendant, no staff, no crowns, no horns. Rounded 3D miniature game creature, matte hand-painted tactile finish, restrained sculpted texture, readable not hyper-detailed bark or thousands of leaves. Plain warm gray studio background. Make a clean 3-column x2-row sheet: TOP row same healthy creature front, right side, back at same scale, both twig arms and root feet visible according to view; BOTTOM row THREE FULL-BODY acting states at same camera and size: 1 healthy and calmly pointing one twig arm toward the path, 2 uncertain, pointing arm dropping and eyes confused, 3 SAME body and colors still recognizable, a thin semi-transparent smoky charcoal-gray ink film mostly around lower trunk and roots, eyes dimmer and anxious, a small backward step. The third is forgetting knowledge, NOT death, injury, evil evolution or a bigger monster; no red eyes, fangs, violent pose, fire or scary smoke cloud. Ensure full leaf canopy, arms, nuts and feet remain present across all six depictions, no cropped bodies. Soft matching studio light. No text, no lettering, no labels, no arrows, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: NIHON QUEST V00 everyday prop continuity sheet. Reference image 1 anchors town props and matte timber/paper materials. Reference image 2 anchors ONLY the small brown-red leather field notebook held by the child, not the child herself; render no characters. On a warm neutral gray studio background arrange a clean spacious SIX-GROUP 3x2 prop sheet, groups separated by whitespace and no drawn borders. Group1: horizontal rectangular pale wooden apple-stall sign in a darker timber frame like reference1, completely BLANK; Group2: a small signpost with EXACTLY TWO broad blank pale-wood arrows pointing opposite ways, same wood materials; Group3: red apples, THREE loose apples prominently separate, plus one shallow round wicker basket EMPTY and a second same-design basket with THREE apples, easy-to-read count; Group4: compact rectangular wooden-bodied hand plane with dark metal blade, one pale half-planed board and three large curled wood shavings, no saw or power tools; Group5: the SAME plain red-brown leather field notebook shown CLOSED and OPEN, simple rounded corners, cream paper, one small brass clasp on a brown strap, no emblem; its open spread is entirely BLANK, same book design as reference2; Group6: two simple cream sheets of paper, one flat and one slightly curled, both completely blank for later numbers and lettering compositing. Simplified high-quality matte 3D game props, large clean shapes, softened edges, modest wood grain and subtle fabric/leather feel, scale practical for 3-head-tall game villagers. Every object fully visible, no overlap between groups. No text anywhere, no digits, no pseudo-writing, no symbols, no labels, no UI, no logos, no watermark. No jewelry, magical books, sparkles, glowing runes, overly complex engraving or realistic grime.

Edit target: supplied six-group prop reference sheet. Make ONE targeted correction only. In the TOP RIGHT group, the RIGHT-HAND FILLED wicker basket currently has TWO apples. Replace ONLY the contents of that right-hand basket so it contains EXACTLY THREE red apples, all three clearly visible and individually countable: arrange as a wide triangle, two in front and one centered behind, all three tops and stems visible above rim, with clear separation and no fourth apple. Slightly lower that basket's front rim ONLY if necessary to see all three apples. Preserve the THREE separate loose apples above the baskets exactly, and preserve the EMPTY basket to the left exactly. Preserve the notebook, papers, wooden plane, board, shavings, wooden signs, overall composition, lighting, textures and background unchanged. Do not add or remove any other objects or writing. This is a game arithmetic continuity reference: 3 loose apples, 0 apples in left basket, EXACTLY 3 apples in right basket. No text or numbers.

Preserve rounded toy-like 3D identity from sheet2; NOT realistic human bodies or anime drawings. Ground all feet and cast matching soft contact shadows. Keep camera and perspective of image1, no montage or panels. Everyday calm expressions before the loss of knowledge, no tragedy, magic, particles or dramatic pose. Signs remain BLANK for later compositing. This is a casting/set compatibility proof, not a finished movie frame. No captions, letters, numerals, logos or watermark.
